Short answer: we can accommodate, but there are a few constraints for that specific week because US DST already went into effect and EU shifts shortly after. That creates a one-week period where a 10:00 AM ET call is 15:00 CET for most of the EU, but for some locales (UK/IE) the offset will temporarily be different depending on their changeover. To keep things consistent for your EU execs, we can do either:

Options:
1) Move the demo to Apr 8 at 09:00 ET / 14:00 CET — keeps EU in their preferred window and still workable for our US presenters. (Preferred)
2) Keep Apr 7 10:00 ET but record and schedule a short live recap for EU leadership at 16:00 CET on Apr 9 so they join a concise Q&A. (If execs can't attend live)
3) Run two shorter sessions: one tailored to US hours and another for EU/APAC (we'd need slightly different slide emphasis).

Marissa — can you confirm presenter availability for option 1? Grace — can you own the recording + succinct Q&A plan if we do option 2?

Jonas
